topic_score.why: Every digital buyer has to download the game before launch day, and it is a very big download.

title: GTA 6 pre-load starts NOV 12, a week EARLY...
description: GTA 6 digital pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12, a week before the game launches on November 19. Pre-loading does not let you play early, but it gets a download of over 200 GB out of the way.

lines.say: You can download GTA 6 a full week before it comes out. Here's why that matters.
Digital pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12.

beats.text: Digital pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12.
beats.label: Confirmed

lines.say: The game itself launches on November 19, on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
But here's the catch. Pre-loading does not let you play early.
So why bother? The PS5 download is reported to be over 200 gigabytes.
You waited about 13 years. Don't spend launch night watching a download bar.
Start it on November 12, and you are ready when GTA 6 is expected to unlock at midnight local time.

beats.text: Expected to unlock at midnight local time.
beats.label: Launch
